Peak extraction game. They took the concept of Lethal Company (although R.E.P.O. is not based off of Lethal) and turned it into the goofiest game I have ever played. Seriously, watching a giant death beam raze through my life savings has never been so much fun. The cool thing about this game, similar to Lethal and Content Warning, is that 90% of the humor that comes from this game is made by the players themselves. I cannot tell you how many times I've waited on the lobby screen just screaming my butt off because of the goofy lil robot heads. R.E.P.O. specifically expands upon that the most by adding things like breakable items, crazy weapons and traps, and monsters that have just the right amount of danger.
